title: fix(cli)!: os build refuses a field the __c extension-field reservation refuses, as os validate does (#28727)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6mHGkBS1EHQfRT9qA8xjAT)_

Fixes #28727

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
`os build` used to emit `dist/objectstack.json` for a package source whose field breaks the `__c` reservation; it now refuses that build. The spelling it newly refuses has a measured count of 0 on this base (below). No `packages/spec/**` or `packages/metadata-protocol/**` file is touched; no schema, type, export or error code moves.

Metadata-protocol: none
What a metadata author can write is unchanged at every metadata door: the save, restore and publish doors, `os validate` and the marketplace install already refuse the same fields with the same judge since #28564 (PR #28724). This only moves the same verdict to the build, as #28643 (PR #28681) did for the override write gate, which declared the same pair.

Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a field spelled with the `__c` suffix or what `os build` refuses for one (`git grep` of the suffix over `skills/**` on this base: 0 hits); the `objectstack-data` skill's "Object Extension Model" section names no field spelling, so it stays true.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os build` 现在和 `os validate` 一样检查 `__c` 扩展字段后缀(ADR-0146 D10)。普通包里出现 `x__c` 字段、或 `.custom` 配对包的扩展字段不带 `__c`,构建直接失败(退出码 1),`dist/` 里什么都不写。
- 为什么改:#28564 让保存/发布/安装/`os validate` 都拒这两种写法,唯独 `os build` 还会产出一个到处都会被拒的产物。现在发货的那道门当场拒,和 #28681 对覆盖声明门做的事一样。
- 风险与回滚:同一个判官、同一条遍历(`findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals`),没有第二份拼写;新拒的拼法在本基点上实测 0 个字段名。回滚即 revert,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` 的 3b-iii-bis 一段(紧跟覆盖声明门,在任何产物写入之前);`packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` 的台账行搬家。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/build-extension-field-suffix.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 4 passed (4)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(合同审查后)。

## What changes

- **`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`**: step 3b-iii-bis calls `findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals` (`utils/extension-field-suffix.ts`, over `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `judgeExtensionFieldSuffix`), the call `os validate` makes at its step 3a-iv. It sits right after #28681's override gate (3b-iii) and ahead of every artifact write, so a refused build writes nothing to `dist/`. Same package-id reading as validate: each `packages[]` entry under its own id, else the stack under `manifest.id`; a stack naming no id is not judged. Faces: `--json` answers this command's failure envelope (`success: false`, `errors` = the rows `os validate --json` carries), the text face prints `os validate`'s heading and bullet rows; exit 1 in both. No second walk, and neither the suffix nor the pair rule is spelled here.
- **`packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`**: the `findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals` row leaves `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` for `SHARED_NON_REGISTRY_GATES`, with its reason; the ledger is `{}` again and its docblock now names the three rows it has held and closed.
- **`.changeset/28727-build-extension-field-suffix.md`**: `@objectstack/cli` patch, both declaration lines, BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

## Tests

- New `packages/cli/test/build-extension-field-suffix.test.ts` (4, unit tier; `os build` and `os validate` run in-process, the recipe of `build-override-declarations.test.ts`):
  - case (a), a plain package's own object field `x__c`, and case (b), the `com.acme.crm.custom` pair extending `crm_account` with a plain `region`: `os build --json` exits as `os validate --json` does (1), `errors` deep-equals validate's rows for the same config (anti-vacuity: exactly one `VALIDATION_ERROR` row with the expected `rule` and path), and `dist/` does not exist afterwards;
  - the text face of case (b) exits 1 and prints validate's refusal block verbatim, with no "Build complete";
  - CONTROL: the pair extending with `region__c` validates clean and builds, the artifact carrying `region__c`.
- **Red on base**: `compile.ts` restored to `db357f6d` (tests kept): 4 failed / 32 passed across the new file and the parity file (the three build pins with `expected +0 to be 1`, and the parity pin "compile.ts no longer calls findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals"); the control stays green. Restore proved by `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD's.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once, blob `8f239dd8` to `7cc70658`): the compile call replaced by an empty row list: 4 failed / 32 passed, the same four pins. Restore: blob equal to HEAD (`8f239dd8`), `git diff HEAD` empty. The command runs from `src` (the test imports `../src/commands/compile`), so no `dist/` sits on the path.

## Acceptance notes

- Serial constraint with #28728 (#28565), which adds a row to the same parity file and a step to `validate.ts`: whichever lands second merges `origin/main` once and keeps both rows (order ruling 5). This branch has not merged it.
- The text face prints `os validate`'s heading for this gate verbatim, as the override gate's build face prints validate's; the text pin asserts the two blocks equal.

## Verification

Run on `4eb1b66430` (base `db357f6d`; `origin/main` has since moved by 8 commits, none touching this diff's files; not merged, see the deviation below). Each test command under `os-verify-lock` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli...' build` exit 0; the dogfood closure `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit tier (`vitest run --project unit`): Test Files 366 passed (366); Tests 5180 passed (5180). The new file is unit tier (in-process, no spawn); the integration tier is declared to CI (no integration-tier file or spawn entry is touched).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/cli`: exit 0.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, owed by the narrowing arm): Test Files 374 passed, 3 skipped (377); Tests 3034 passed, 28 skipped (3062).
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 61 families, each exit captured before any pipe), reconciled: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 61 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. `check:i18n-coverage` first read 3 (`@objectstack/connector-slack` had no build output in this worktree) and read 0 after building it: `OK (14 config(s), 527 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`.
- Count (the narrowing's migration note): `git grep -nE "[a-z0-9]__c\b"` over `examples/**`, `packages/*/src/**`, `skills/**`, tests excluded, at `origin/main` `db357f6d`: 8 hits, all doc comments (`protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts`, `field-customization.ts`, `object.zod.ts`, `validation.zod.ts`); 0 field names.
- Deviation: `origin/main` was not merged before opening. The 8 incoming commits touch none of the four files here; in `packages/cli` they change only `src/utils/override-declarations.test.ts`. CI's merge-group run judges the joint tree; the serial merge with #28728 stays owed by whichever lands second.
